item.description: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court directed the Election Commission (EC) on Monday to display the names of those on the “logical discrepancies” list at gram panchayat bhavans, block offices of talukas and ward offices in West Bengal. item.title: Unnao rape: Delhi High Court dismisses Sengar’s plea to suspend sentence in death case of survivor’s father
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Delhi High Court on Monday refused to suspend the 10-year sentence awarded to expelled BJP leader Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the case of the death of the Unnao rape survivor’s father while in custody. “No grounds are made out for grant relief. item.title: CBI arrests HPCL sales officer for taking Rs 1 lakh bribe
item.description: NEW DELHI: The CBI has arrested a sales officer of the Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), Chandrapur in Maharashtra for allegedly taking a bribe of Rs 1 lakh to hand over the company’s retail outlet, officials said on Monday. item.title: Security Forces Conduct Mock Drill at Qazigund Railway Station to Test Emergency Preparedness
item.description: KULGAM: A joint team of security forces on Monday carried out a comprehensive mock drill at Qazigund Railway Station to assess emergency preparedness and enhance passenger safety measures, officials said. The drill was jointly conducted by Kulgam Police, the Army’s 9 Rashtriya Rifles (9RR), CRPF, SDRF, Fire and Emergency Services (F&ES), IRP, and health teams. [...]

item.description: JAMMU: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah on Monday said Kashmiri Pandits are always welcome to return to their homes in the Valley, as the displaced community observed the 36th anniversary of their exodus in Jammu and reiterated demands for a comprehensive policy on their return and rehabilitation.
